about: Trails drawn as an ORMA illustration by scripts/render-trail-illustrations.js, because no licensed photograph of the walk exists or the one it carried showed somewhere else. An illustrated trail stays Reviewed and is never Verified; when a real photograph is uploaded and reviewed it replaces the illustration. Distances are from the old photograph's camera to the walk's line.

Le Marais de Pré Lombard: the only picture had no licence; none of the marsh exists on Commons or Panoramax
Marmottes: no picture; only winter ski-slope frames exist
